headline: Diagnosed: campus firewall blocks acm.org; awaiting admin approval.
text: The owner's laptop could not load acm.org. Uni checked its own gateway and found a firewall rule dropping all traffic to acm.org's network, but refused to remove it without administrator approval. Not yet resolved: the block stays until admins approve the change.
